task: Find family-owned German machine-tool manufacturers (Mittelstand) with 100-500 employees

ownership_changes.why: The company name points to the Friedrich family as limited partners, and wer-zu-wem lists it as a family business with an individual owner (Michael Reich). No institutional owner is shown, so it passes under the one rule.
The evidence shows a family-led company with an individual owner and no PE or other institutional owner.
